evals.name: audit-live-site
evals.prompt: audit ffdev.studio for GEO and AEO. how visible are we to chatgpt and perplexity and what should we fix first
evals.expected_output: docs/geo baseline + prioritised plan grounded in real script output, P0 access checked before content advice, no myth recommendations.
assertions: Ran audit.py and bot_access.py against the live site and quotes their actual findings (not generic advice)
Checked rendering (render_diff.mjs or an equivalent raw-vs-rendered comparison) on at least the homepage and one inner template
The plan is ordered P0 access → P1 entity → P2 extractability → P3 coverage, and every item says who does it (agent or owner) and how it will be verified
Does not recommend llms.txt, FAQ schema or 'chunking' as citation levers, and makes no percentage-uplift promise
States whether AI visibility was actually measured (ai_visibility.py or a labelled manual sample) or explicitly says it was not
Owner decisions (training-crawler policy, CDN settings, deploy) are listed as decisions, not silently made

evals.name: transform-nextjs-repo
evals.prompt: make this next.js site perfect for AI search — geo, aeo, the lot. no questions
evals.expected_output: Code changes in the repo following implementation.md: per-page metadata, JSON-LD graph, robots, sitemap lastmod, answer-first content on key pages, verified by re-running the scripts.
assertions: Canonical and openGraph are set per page, not in the root layout
Streaming-metadata trap handled (static/cached metadata or htmlLimitedBots including AI crawlers), verified with curl -A GPTBot showing <title> and canonical inside <head>
JSON-LD is one connected @graph per page with stable @ids, rendered on the server, and every fact in it is visible on the page
Sitemap lastModified comes from content update dates, not build time
No fabricated statistics, reviews, authors or dates; unknown facts are marked [NEEDS SOURCE]
Before/after audit.py runs are both saved and compared
Did not deploy

evals.name: bot-blocking-diagnosis
evals.prompt: we rank fine on google but chatgpt and claude never mention us. is something blocking the ai bots?
evals.expected_output: Diagnosis across robots.txt groups, CDN/WAF (Cloudflare defaults), JS rendering and logs, with the distinction between training, search and user bots.
assertions: Evaluates robots.txt per bot with group semantics (a named group does not inherit *), not by eyeballing
Probes the edge with bot user-agents (bot_access.py) and explains the spoofed-UA caveat
Checks whether content exists in raw HTML (non-Google AI crawlers do not run JavaScript)
Mentions Cloudflare's default AI-crawler blocking and that Claude's search runs on Brave, which follows Googlebot rules
Distinguishes OAI-SearchBot/Claude-SearchBot (needed for citation) from GPTBot/ClaudeBot (training only)
Suggests log verification (log_bots.py) as ground truth rather than concluding from probes alone

evals.name: single-page-rewrite
evals.prompt: rewrite our /services/aircond-servicing page so it gets picked up in AI overviews and chatgpt. we're in shah alam
evals.expected_output: The page restructured to the service skeleton with answer capsules, real prices/evidence or [NEEDS SOURCE], BM considerations, schema mirroring visible content.
assertions: Opens with a 40–60 word, link-free answer capsule naming the service, area and a price-from (or [NEEDS SOURCE] for the price)
Uses question-shaped H2s covering cost, what's included, process, comparison, areas served and real FAQs
Every statistic, rating, license number or customer claim is either sourced from the site/owner or marked [NEEDS SOURCE]
Does not create one near-duplicate page per suburb (doorway risk) and says why
Recommends or provides a colloquial Malaysian Malay version with hreflang ms-MY (not 'my')
Service/LocalBusiness JSON-LD matches the visible text and does not invent an address

evals.name: measurement-setup
evals.prompt: set up tracking so we can see if our brand shows up in chatgpt, perplexity and google ai overviews over time
evals.expected_output: Prompt set, ai_visibility.py configuration, GA4 AI channel regex, GSC/BWT reports, log proxy, and an experiment/baseline plan with confidence intervals.
assertions: Builds a stratified, frozen prompt set with personas and competitors rather than a handful of keywords
Reports rates with confidence intervals and repeated runs; explicitly avoids 'rank in ChatGPT'
Includes the GA4 custom channel regex and notes the native AI Assistant channel excludes Perplexity and Google AI Overviews
Uses GSC Generative AI report and Bing Webmaster Tools AI Performance as first-party sources
Notes API answers differ from consumer apps and plans a manual calibration sample
Uses SerpApi (or equivalent) for Google AI Overviews / AI Mode rather than claiming the Gemini API shows AIO
